item.title: Linux DAW: Help Linux musicians to quickly and easily find the tools they need
Kubernetes egress control with squid proxy
item.description:
📝 Squid logs everything that passes through. That’s it, and this gives us: I used Squid deliberately because it predates Kubernetes and most “cloud-native” tooling, but still does exactly what this problem requires: explicit HTTP/HTTPS egress control, logging, and policy enforcement. Without the proxy environment variables configured, workloads in this namespace cannot reach the outside world.
🔗 Read more: https://interlaye.red/kubernetes_002degress_002dsquid.html

item.description:

item.title: Market design can feed the poor
item.description:
📝 The system operated in ignorance of what food banks needed. Food banks received an average of 20 percent of their food from Feeding America with the rest coming from local sources that headquarters knew nothing about. Donors often gave food close to expiration dates, and the centralized system couldn’t quickly match time-sensitive donations with food banks that needed them.
🔗 Read more: https://worksinprogress.co/issue/how-market-design-can-feed-the-poor/
